GOV-F-003-S33.title: Brain Lock Schema and Ownership Contract
GOV-F-003-S33.description: Define and persist lock schema including lock_id, owner_id, TTL timestamp, and status. Enforce ownership contract for all lock operations, ensuring only the owner can renew or release a lock.

GOV-F-003-S34.title: Lock Management API Endpoints
GOV-F-003-S34.description: Expose internal APIs for lock acquisition, renewal, release, and forced recovery. Ensure endpoints enforce ownership validation and TTL checks before allowing state transitions.

GOV-F-003-S35.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S35.description: Integrate lock acquisition, renewal, and release into Brain runner execution flow to ensure all assignments operate under enforced lock ownership and respect TTL expiration and recovery rules.
